Searched memory across Jun 28 – Jul 28. Two notes first: the `project="claude-mem"` filter returns nothing because projects are stored worktree-qualified (`claude-mem/freckle-nail`, `claude-mem-pro/flame-jujube`), and the startup index you got this session stopped at Jun 18 — the actual database has 30 more days of work in it. The last 30 days were basically one arc: **rebuild sync → ship the product → survive launch.**

## Late June — release cleanup
v13.9.1 published to npm (verified after "i published it before"), a patch release on Jun 30, and a `release/recovery-2026-06-24` branch sitting on ~80 uncommitted changes with no PR.

## Jul 2–8 — cloud sync, first attempt
Mapped the claude-mem-pro API surface, built the batch/tombstone sync routes, and wrote `cloud-sync.mjs` — a two-way client with device identity and a pull lane. Installed it to `~/.claude-mem/` on Jul 8 and ran the initial backfill: **129,777 rows pushed**. Also documented the three-branch release model in `docs/public/branches.mdx`.

## Jul 9 — the architectural pivot
The standalone sync daemon got deleted before it shipped. Realization: the worker's write hooks already existed, so polling was redundant. Decision #101189 — **"database as queue"**: add a `synced_at` column, drop all daemon/cursor/polling infrastructure. Executed same day — schema v36, the worker-native CloudSync flusher, PR #3182, the `/cloud-sync` skill, and `docs/public/cloud-sync.mdx`. v13.10.2 out with the new release branch structure.

## Jul 11–12 — Pro UI and two real bugs
Timeline viewer work in claude-mem-pro: alt SessionCard design (tinted head, three faces), live animation cycle — PR #46 merged and deployed to cmem.ai. Then bugs: the SessionStart hook runtime not initializing (GitHub #3206), and prompt-to-session attachment broken — **0 of the 50 newest sessions had prompts in the cloud viewer**.

## Jul 17–19 — two-lane sync
v13.11.0 integrated CloudSync with SSE broadcasting. `synced_at` migration chain through schema v39/v40. Serious build-vs-buy research — Electric, cr-sqlite, Turso embedded replicas, Automerge 3, LiveStore, Turso pricing — then built it: `SyncClient.ts` pull loop, six phases complete on `feat/phase5-two-lane-sync`. A Postgres→Turbopuffer cutover plan was rewritten alongside.

## Jul 22–23 — launch plan, then the storm
`plans/2026-07-22-cmem-launch.md` — a 5-phase executable launch plan, run repeatedly through `/do`. v13.12.0 shipped two-lane sync and immediately caused a **485-restart worker storm**. v13.12.1 and v13.12.2 hotfixed same day; v13.12.3 fixed a stale-worker recycle loop (npm publish timed out and needed verification). v13.12.4 closed issues #3378–#3381 through an "orchestrator-of-orchestrators" pipeline — parallel subagents per fix, PRs #3389–#3391 babysat through CI. That's the version this worktree is sitting on.

## Jul 24 — go to market
Explicit decision at a night hack event: claude-mem ships commercially via cmem.ai. Stripe billing configured on the live CMEM, Inc. Atlas account, 4 active prices validated. Launch gate report written, then rewritten as a plain-language public narrative and turned into NotebookLM/WOWerpoint decks.

## Jul 25 — launch day, real customers, live surgery
Money came in and the funnel broke in the ways funnels do. Checkout is guest-first — Stripe collects the email, `/activate` claims the account — so buyers were paying and never activating. Founding subscribers found stranded ([REDACTED:name]; [REDACTED:name] paid but never activated, needed outreach). Fixes shipped to production during the day:

- **PRs #71–#74** — paywall flash before auth resolves, already-subscribed guard, orphan adoption, activate-screen copy
- **Orphan adoption in `/api/pro/status`** — self-heals paid customers who never completed `/activate`; verified live on a real account
- **PR #75 auto-login** — verified in production

Metrics moved from 8 users at 4am to **19 auth users / 17 pro rows** by midday, near-100% conversion in the early hours. Open loose ends at last check: 4 duplicate subscriptions on promo codes pending your review, magic-link buyers from before the fix still unclaimed, and the Resend "Account Ready" broadcast stuck as a draft on a contacts quota.

A `/loop` launch-watch ran ~17+ iterations on a 30-minute cadence across Stripe, Supabase, GitHub, and Vercel — mostly all-clear.

**Jul 26–27: nothing captured.** Today's only entry before this one was confirming the `what-the` skill is public on GitHub.
